title: AgentStatus v1
description: Device-facing agent status contract (lab draft feeding AW-004). State codes and message keys are stable and language-independent; the device maps them to display copy. 'activity' is opaque content (e.g. a task title) rendered as-is, never localized. This file is a working input to AW-004, not the ratified protocol contract.

state.description: Stable status code; display copy comes from a message key, never from this string

activity.description: Opaque short content shown as-is (not localized)

task.description: Task id or title, opaque content

seq.description: Monotonic per-agent sequence for ordering/loss detection
